name: multi-selector
blurb: Searchable multi-select with badges and select-all.
description: A fully-featured multi-select component with search, optional badges showing selections, select-all option, and support for displaying extra count when exceeding maxCount.
use_when: Users need to select multiple options with quick search and visual feedback.
avoid_when: Single selection or simple multi-select lists.
a11y: Keyboard navigable; search input; checkboxes show selection state.

props.name: options
props.type: {label: string; value: string; icon?: React.ComponentType; disable?: boolean}[]
